topic: Rocks D. Xebec once conquered Hachinosu, and Blackbeard now rules the same island, named his flagship the Saber of Xebec, and wants Hachinosu recognized as a nation, a side point of the crew-building story
title: The Island Rocks Ruled Before Blackbeard Ever Did
description: Rocks D. Xebec conquered the lawless island of Hachinosu and ruled over every criminal on it. Decades later, his son Blackbeard sits on that exact same island and named his flagship after his father. Is this a tribute, or a plan?
comment: Is Teach copying Rocks on purpose, or did Hachinosu just happen to be the best hideout?

lines.text: Rocks D. Xebec once conquered the lawless island of Hachinosu.

shot.fallback: lawless island port with pirate banners

lines.text: He brought every criminal on it under his control and ruled there for years.

shot.fallback: pirate captain overlooking a crowded island town

lines.text: Blackbeard's base today is that exact same island.

shot.fallback: dark pirate throne room on an island

lines.text: He didn't just pick a convenient hideout. He ousted Ochoku, a former subordinate of Rocks.

shot.fallback: new ruler taking a throne from an old one

lines.text: Teach also named his flagship the Saber of Xebec, a tribute to his father.

shot.fallback: grand pirate flagship with a dark sail

lines.text: Some say it's just a cool ship name. Fair, but look at what he's doing with the island.

shot.fallback: pirate map spread across a table

lines.text: Teach wants Hachinosu recognized as an official nation, the Blackbeard Kingdom.

shot.fallback: crown resting on a stone pedestal

lines.text: Here's my read: the island is the clearest proof the son inherited the plan.

shot.search: Marshall D. Teach Hachinosu Rocks Xebec
shot.fallback: father and son silhouettes over an island

lines.text: So why does Teach want a nation this badly? That's the bigger story.

shot.search: Marshall D. Teach ambition world recognition
shot.fallback: ambitious pirate gazing toward a distant capital

lines.text: That's why the throne Blackbeard sits on was first his father's.

shot.fallback: empty throne in a dim pirate hall

self_check.hook: hidden detail: same island, same throne, with the flagship name as the side point
self_check.loop: last line leads into line 0 (Rocks conquered the island)
